items.current: Preparation worker only checks eligibility/idle state and obtains the internal secret. Main event thread alone accepts a per-request ticket, submits the native export, registers its exact ID, polls and stops it. Stop/destruction invalidates the ticket; queued late completion does no export but still erases its secret and closes the producer lease. State/ID comparison and cancellation hold the NativeBackupJobs monitor together. Old parameters and callbacks cannot clear a newer ticket. Existing native worker-quiescence remains the factory-reset deletion barrier.
